verdict.rationale: A government corporate-registry service could plausibly publish a machine-readable API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the documented interfaces are web forms, fillable PDFs, upload/fax/mail, and a CAPTCHA-gated filing portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
